title: Build bounded context and worker handoff packets
description: Build the bounded handoff packet for delegated tasks. Already present: structured briefs (objective, constraints, acceptance criteria, context references, each capped at 12 items) in managed-tasks, and a per-project task registry. Remaining: assemble only the relevant confirmed memory and plan facts into the packet, with size limits, and show the packet contents in task status.
why: Blindly forwarding transcripts makes delegation expensive and unreliable.

acceptance.text: Long conversation stays inside a configured budget
Compaction preserves constraints and unresolved work
Handoff contains no unrelated project context
A stale summary can be traced and corrected
